answer: Budget the enclave: 1 hour to provision a TEE-backed key, 40 minutes per re-attestation, 0 hours for a key that never proves one. Weight attestations by independent path length, so 3 hops through distinct subnetworks count 3 times a direct vote. No identity audits its own recruit. A ridge of 60 cloned enclaves costs 60 provisioning hours before it grades a single orchard task, and the kernel of real work still needs an outside path.
